items.title: Norman Brownlee Interview, 1961-05-05
items.q: Oh, yes, I did. I knew Eddie. I don't know whether they remember me.

ctx.x: I'm sure you knew him, Daddy.
Oh, yes, I did. I knew Eddie. I don't know whether they remember me. I remember Swoboda, too. No, was it Shabarra or Swoboda? The drummer? The drummer.
